Learn to Swim

Lessons for infants through adults in the Woollett Teaching Pool. Classes meet Monday and Wednesday or Tuesday and Thursday for 25 or 40 minutes, or on Saturdays, in two- to four-week sessions. Register or read the class descriptions.

  • Ducklings, 6 to 30 months, with a parent
  • Parent & Little Fish, Little Fish, ages 2½ to 5½: Starfish through Sharks
  • Big Fish, ages 6 to 13: Hippos, Turtles, Eels, Dolphins, Marlins
  • Teen and adult lessons
  • Adaptive: Angelfish (one to one) and Guppies (one to three)
  • Private and semi-private lessons
  • H2O Dive, ages 7 to 13, March to October; H2O Polo, ages 9 to 14, summer
